summary: The file area's message and its placeholders now wait for there to be no group header either, and the message has the empty-space menu. src/finder/groups.rs: `shows_nothing()` is true with no rows and no header that the current view draws (`rows.is_empty() && (groups.is_empty() || !grouping_active())`). src/finder/mod.rs `render_content`: the message branch and the placeholder branch go by `shows_nothing()` where they went by `rows.is_empty()`; the other terms of the message branch (`!loading`, `!awaits_first_results()`, the running-filter guard) are as they were. A list or icon view whose groups are all collapsed therefore draws its headers, in a folder, in a folder reached with groups already collapsed, in search results, Recents and the Trash. The non-error message (`render_message(..).when(..)`) gets `.context_menu(.. menus::background_menu ..)`; the row of buttons under a message stops a right press, so a button has no menu. `#content` has one more capture-phase mouse-down listener, which clears `item_menu_at` at every right press in the file area, so a mark left by an earlier press on an item no longer swallows the empty-space menu at the same point. `filtered` in the EmptyInput loses `&& self.groups.is_empty()`: with a header on screen there is no message. src/finder/trash.rs: `trash_is_empty()` (`unfiltered_len == 0`); the Trash bar's Empty… button and the menu's Empty Trash… item (src/finder/menus.rs) go by it, so collapsed groups or a filter that hide every item no longer dim them. `empty_message`: a `Location::Results` arm, "No Items" / "The items listed here can no longer be found."; the folder arm is `Location::Folder(_)`, and the match is exhaustive. docs/manual.md: the Groups paragraph, the Empty-space menu section, the Trash's Empty… bullet and the No Items row of the message table.
changelog: Collapsing every group of a list or icon view no longer replaces the view with "No Items. This folder is empty." The headers stay, each with its count, so a group can be opened again with a click. The same goes for a folder that opens with all of its groups already collapsed, since a tab remembers collapsed groups from folder to folder, and for search results, Recents, and the Trash, which read "No Results", "No Recent Files", and "The Trash Is Empty" with items in them. An empty folder now has the empty-space menu: right-click anywhere in it for New Folder, Paste, Show Hidden Files, and the rest, where a right-click did nothing. So has the file area under its other messages, such as "No Results", except the ones about a folder or a Trash that can't be read. A right-click on empty space now also opens its menu at the exact point where an item's menu was last opened, once the item has gone from there or its folder has been opened with the pointer at rest, where the first such click opened nothing. In the Trash, **Empty…** and Empty Trash… are no longer dimmed while a filter or collapsed groups hide every item. Results sent from Nushell whose items have all been moved or deleted say that the items can no longer be found, where they said "This folder is empty."
behaviour_changes: List and icon views with every group collapsed show the group headers (name, count, right-pointing arrow) instead of "No Items / This folder is empty."; a click on a header opens its group. In the list the column headings and the striped filler rows show under them. Tested, and pictured in light and dark.

The same for a folder opened with its groups already collapsed (a tab keeps collapsed groups from folder to folder), for search results (was "No Results" with its line and buttons about the scope and the kind), Recents (was "No Recent Files") and the Trash (was "The Trash Is Empty"). A folder and a search are tested; the Trash is tested in tests/file_ops.rs.

With every group collapsed the keys and the mouse find no item: the arrow keys, Home and End, Page Down, Select All, type-to-select, Space, Return and a box dragged over the headers select and open nothing, in the list and in the icon view (tested for both; Space and Return probed).

While the next place is being read, a list or icon view that was fully collapsed keeps the headers of the place it left, where it showed placeholders; non-collapsed rows always stayed the same way. A folder that opens as a gallery (or as columns) from there still shows what it did: placeholders, or its columns. Probed, and the gallery case is tested.

A right-click anywhere on the message of an empty file area opens the empty-space menu: an empty folder (New Folder, New File…, Paste and Move Here when the clipboard holds files, Open Nushell Here, Run Nushell Pipeline…, Get Info, Add Folder to Sidebar, Select All, View, Sort By, Show Hidden Files, Refresh), "No Results", "No Items Pass the Filter", "Indexing…", "Searching…", the time-limit and cut-short messages, an empty Recents or sent results (no New Folder or Paste) and an empty Trash (a lone disabled Empty Trash…). In all four views, in split view (the commands act on the pane that was clicked; probed in review, before and after the rebase) and in the file chooser. The menu gives the keyboard back to where it was, for example the search field (tested).

New Folder from that menu is named in place: the name field has the keyboard, Return names the folder, and the files have the keyboard after it (tested in review, also with the keyboard in the search field and from the other pane of split view by probe). Paste Item and Show Hidden Files from it leave the keyboard in the files (probed).
Not on the buttons under a message: a right-click on one opens no menu and gives the button the keyboard, as before (tested).

A right-click on empty space at the exact point where an item's menu was last opened now opens the empty-space menu. Before, the first such press opened nothing: in a view after the item had gone from under a pointer at rest (probed in the list, with the last row removed by another program and with it sent to the Trash by its key; the icons and the columns set and read the same mark), and on the message after a folder was right-clicked, the menu closed with Escape and the folder opened with Return (probed; a double-click leaves the pointer in the same place). Until 4e5b448 (focus-lost-recovery) that press also left every key dead until a click. Tested for the list and for the message.

A menu left open on the message when the first item arrives goes with the message, and the files have the keyboard (by the net of focus-lost-recovery; tested here with a hidden file that Show Hidden Files brings in).

Trash: Empty… in the bar and Empty Trash… in the menu are enabled whenever the Trash lists items, also when collapsed groups or a filter hide all of them (they were dimmed). Still dimmed for an empty Trash. Both ask before they erase, and erase what the Trash holds, as before. Tested.
Results sent from Nushell (fff show) with none of their items left read "No Items / The items listed here can no longer be found." where they read "This folder is empty." Tested.
Manual: four edits (the Groups paragraph, the Empty-space menu section, the Trash's Empty… bullet, the No Items row).
Unchanged: the status bar's counts, the two error messages (no menu), the texts of the other messages, columns and gallery while they have items.
left_out: CHANGELOG.md is not edited, per the guide. The entry is in this record and in the commit message.

The status bar still counts the rows that show (the plan of record said to leave it): "0 items" under headers whose counts add up to more, and with a filter on "0 of N items pass the filter" when the items that pass are all in collapsed groups. It already counted short with one group collapsed. See Found, not fixed.
The messages for a folder or a Trash that can't be read have no menu, as the plan said.
The gallery still has no empty-space menu while it has items (out of scope per the verifier). An empty folder shown as a gallery or as columns does have the menu, through the message.
No picture of the Trash (the screenshot example would use this machine's real Trash) or of the sent-results message (the example can't reach it). Headless tests cover both.

New Folder or New File… while the new item's group is collapsed still starts a name edit in a field that is never drawn, and the file list takes no click and no key until the group is opened. It was there before by the key and the Actions menu; the message's menu is one more way to it, and the header this change keeps is the way out. See Found, not fixed: it is the first thing there, and worth a brief of its own.

`item_menu_at` and `take_item_menu_click` are kept, with the mark now cleared at each right press. The kit's context menus stop a press at the innermost one, so the mark may guard nothing any more; taking it out was not needed for this fix and touches three places other lanes work in.

Nothing was compiled or run for macOS or Windows: no cfg-gated code is touched, no signature changed, and the one new import (`ContextMenuExt` in src/finder/mod.rs) is used on every platform. `cargo clippy --features term` was not run: src/term is untouched and calls nothing that changed (checked with grep).
README.md and the Search Syntax dialog state nothing this changes.

review_fixes: Found with a probe and fixed: the message's new menu could be swallowed by a mark an item had left. An item records where it was right-clicked (`item_menu_at`) so that the empty-space menu around it stays closed for that press, and nothing cleared the record until the next press on empty space; `background_menu` then returned an empty menu when that press was at the same point, and the kit gives an empty menu the keyboard without drawing it. The message made this easy to meet: right-click a folder, Escape, Return (or a double-click), and the folder that opens empty has its message under the pointer, where the next right-click (for New Folder) opened nothing and, before 4e5b448, left every key dead until a click. The same was there before this change in the views (probed in the list: the last row removed with the pointer at rest, then a right-click at the same point). Fix: one capture-phase `capture_any_mouse_down` listener on `#content` in `render_content` clears the mark at every right press in the file area; an item's own listener sets it again in the bubble phase of the same press, so the same-press meaning is unchanged. Test: the_empty_space_menu_opens_where_an_items_menu_did_before, seen failing without the listener at 'this press is on no item'.

The same test now also names the new folder made from the message's menu (type a name, Return, the folder has it, it is selected, the files have the keyboard). The implementer's test only checked that the folder was made and pressed Escape; whether the name field has the keyboard once the message is gone is the first thing a user meets.

Added the_keys_work_on_when_the_messages_menu_loses_its_message. The implementer's note 2 (a menu left open on the message when the first item arrives leaves the keyboard on a menu that is no longer drawn) was true on the base it was written on and is cured by focus-lost-recovery, which landed while this was in review: after the rebase the files get the keyboard. The test pins the two changes together; it brings the item in with Show Hidden Files, so it does not lean on file times.

collapsing_every_group_keeps_its_headers: the icon view part only checked that the headers were there. It now drags a box and presses Down, Right and End there too: Up and Down in the icon view go through `icon_step`, which the list's keys never reach.

Commit message: a paragraph on the mark, one on the menu that goes with the message, and a sentence in the Changelog paragraph. The Changelog sentence says only what this commit cures (the press that opened nothing); the dead keys are in focus-lost-recovery's entry.

Rebased twice: onto 4e5b448 (focus-lost-recovery), which adds `keyboard_lost` and `keyboard_stays` to src/finder/mod.rs and tests to tests/controls.rs, and onto 7e5689c (tab-bar-overflow), which touches the tab bar and the workspace only. No conflicts. After the first I probed how the two work together (the message's menu in split view, a menu left open while an item arrives, a button under No Results that a right-click gave the keyboard) and reworded the commit message; check.sh printed CHECK OK after each rebase, the last time on the trunk commit itself.

Nothing of the implementer's source was changed. The deviations from the plan are sound: without `|| !grouping_active()` a gallery opened after collapsed groups draws an empty gallery while it is read (mutation run in review), and with the plan's `shows_nothing()` for the Trash's Empty… the filter case stays dimmed (mutation run in review).
notes:
Checked. With the commit's src diff reverse-applied (before the review's fixes), 5 of the implementer's 6 new tests in tests/controls.rs and both in tests/file_ops.rs fail; the sixth, the gallery test, passes without the change, as a guard on the new predicate should, and fails when `|| !self.grouping_active()` is taken out. The unit test's new row is in the reverted file, so it was checked by mutation instead. Eight mutations of the final code, in three builds, each failed the tests it should: no Results arm (the unit test and the UI test); no grouping_active term (the gallery test); trash_is_empty = shows_nothing() (the filter test only); the bar's button back to rows.is_empty() (the filter test, at 'the bar's button asks'); no stop on the buttons' row (no_results_has…, and a_button_under_no_results_takes_no_keyboard_away_with_it); the placeholder branch back to rows.is_empty() (both group tests); the menu's item back to rows (both Trash tests, at 'the menu's item asks'); the message branch back to rows.is_empty() (both group tests and an_item_in_a_collapsed_group_isnt_hidden_by_the_filter). The review's own listener taken out fails the_empty_space_menu_opens_where_an_items_menu_did_before. check.sh printed CHECK OK on the trunk commit: 730 passed in 16 test binaries, 3 of 3 known root-only failures. The review's tests pass with SEED=0, 3, 11, 77 and 4242. A test's window is not active unless the test activates it, and focus events fire only in an active window, so I ran the main flows again by probe in an activated one, as the app has it: the right-click at the point of an item's menu, New Folder from the message's menu and its name, Paste Item, Escape giving the keyboard back to the search field, no menu on a button, an item arriving under the open menu, the keys and a header click with every group collapsed, and Empty Trash… from the menu with its dialog. All came out as in the kept tests. I took my own pictures: the grouped list open, the list and the icon view (dark) with all five groups of the demo folder collapsed, the menu on an empty folder's message (light) and on No Results with its button (dark).

The three ways I thought this most likely to hurt someone, and what the code and the probes say. (1) The new menu leaves the keyboard dead or sends a command to the wrong place. It did, once, by the stale mark (fixed, above). Otherwise: the menu's commands are dispatched from the menu, which is drawn under the message, so they go up through the pane that was clicked; the kit gives the keyboard back to where it was when the menu closes, and New Folder's name field takes it after that (the dispatch is deferred, the dismissal is not); the message goes when the folder gets its first item, and by then the menu is closed, or the net of focus-lost-recovery gives the files the keyboard. A menu with no items is the one thing that takes the keyboard without showing: the message's menu can only be empty through the mark, and in the Trash it always has its one item. (2) Empty… in the Trash is offered or withheld wrongly. `unfiltered_len` is set in `rebuild_rows`, the only place that sets `rows` and `groups`, so the three are never out of step; an empty Trash has 0 and stays dimmed; a search in the Trash hides the bar; the command asks first and erases what the bin lists, not what the window lists. While the Trash is being read the count is that of the place the window left, so Empty… can be enabled for a moment over a Trash that turns out empty, as it was by that place's rows before. (3) The file area draws nothing at all, or headers no click can use. Headers count only where the view draws them (list and icons); `view_mode`, `use_groups` and `group_by` are each tab's own and change only through `set_view_mode`, `set_group_by` (both rebuild the rows) and `show_folder_view` on arrival (while `loading`, where the message is held back and the gallery and columns show what they did). A search's first letter drops the rows and the groups (`drop_stale_results`), so no folder header stands in for results. With zero rows the list's filler-row maths, the icon layout, the box selection and every selection key hold (tests, and Space and Return by probe).

Doubts that remain, for the owner. (a) "0 items" in the status bar under headers that count 15 reads like a bug, though the manual says the bar counts the items shown; the plan left it. (b) The wording "The items listed here can no longer be found." is the implementer's; "listed" is said of a list that now lists nothing. (c) While the next place is read, the headers of the place left stay, and a click on one toggles that group over the old listing for a moment; rows have always stayed that way, and stale-rows-on-place-change is the brief that decides it. (d) The manual sentence "all of it but the buttons under the message is empty space" is correct but dense. (e) Nothing ran on macOS or Windows.

For briefs still to come.
- stale-rows-on-place-change: `render_content` now asks `shows_nothing()` (src/finder/groups.rs) where it asked `rows.is_empty()`, in the message branch and in the placeholder branch. Group headers are as stale as rows while a place is read: with every group collapsed the headers of the place left now stay on screen (placeholders before), and `render_group_header`'s click calls `toggle_group`, which rebuilds the rows from the old listing. Whatever makes the old rows inert must cover the headers too. If you clear the rows on leaving a place, clear `groups` with them (or go through `rebuild_rows`), or `shows_nothing()` stays false and the headers stay. `trash_is_empty()` reads `unfiltered_len`, which is set in `rebuild_rows` and so is as stale as the rows. a_gallery_shows_placeholders_while_it_is_read_after_collapsed_groups navigates without settling and expects `skeleton` to exist for a gallery right away: if placeholders get a grace period, that line changes with it.
- search-start-no-flash: the same two branches. If the folder's rows are kept through a grace period at the first letter, their group headers are kept with them (`groups` changes only in `rebuild_rows`), and a folder whose groups are all collapsed keeps its headers through it, since `shows_nothing()` is false for it; `drop_stale_results` clears both when it runs. The gallery test above depends on when placeholders show.
- context-menus-fit: `background_menu` (src/finder/menus.rs) disables Empty Trash… by `finder.trash_is_empty()` now, not by `rows_for_test()`. The file area's message has that menu too, so its Trash branch is reached from an empty Trash, where the one item is disabled and still makes the menu non-empty: keep it non-empty, since an empty menu takes the keyboard without being drawn. `item_menu_at` is cleared at each right press in the file area (capture phase on `#content`); if you add a menu inside the file area that should keep the empty-space menu closed for its own press, set the mark from a bubble-phase listener as `right_click_row` does. The manual's Trash bullet now ends "including items that a filter or a collapsed group hides", and the Empty-space menu section has a paragraph about messages before "In the Trash, the empty-space menu has Empty Trash….": keep both when you add the Trash row's menu.
- icon-tile-hit-target: the manual's Empty-space menu section has the new paragraph about messages; keep it. A right press on what becomes empty space between tiles needs nothing for the mark: it is cleared at each press and only an item's own bubble-phase listener sets it. With every group collapsed the icon view has only Header lines (`tile_ranges()` are all empty), so a box started in the margins finds no tile; collapsing_every_group_keeps_its_headers drags one there.
- stray-double-click-opens-file (lane-b, in progress): `#content` in `render_content` now has two `capture_any_mouse_down` listeners. The new one comes first and only clears `item_menu_at` on a right press; the double-click guard with `message_button_clicked` follows it unchanged. If your change rewrites the guard and the rebase conflicts there, keep both.
- filter-stale-keep-set: `EmptyInput.filtered` is `!filter.is_empty() && filter_error.is_none()` now (no `groups` term); the message branch is reached only when `shows_nothing()`. the_trash_empties_with_a_filter_that_hides_its_items sets the filter `size > 1gb` in the Trash and expects no names after it settles, then the message's menu and the bar's button to offer Empty; an_item_in_a_collapsed_group_isnt_hidden_by_the_filter is what holds the message back when the items that pass are in a collapsed group. `unfiltered_len` must stay the count before the filter: the Trash's Empty… reads it.
- select-all-perf: if `rebuild_rows` is reordered, `self.unfiltered_len = rows.len()` has to stay before `apply_filter_to` and `group_rows`; `trash_is_empty()` and the message read it. The status bar's `count` is still `rows.len()`.
- split-active-pane: a right press on the file area's message is stopped by its context menu before the files or the pane's root see it in the bubble phase, as a right press on the views' empty space is. The keyboard stays where it was (possibly in the other pane) while the menu's commands go to the pane that was pressed; after New Folder the name field of that pane has the keyboard. If the active pane should follow such a press, a capture-phase listener sees it.
- adhoc-index-feedback, regex-content-search: a message you add through `empty_message` gets the empty-space menu with no further work (the non-error branch of `render_content`), and its buttons, if any, go in the row that stops right presses. `empty_message`'s match on the place is exhaustive now (`Location::Results` has its own arm). The message branch's first term is `shows_nothing()`.
- restore-session-tabs: a restored tab of sent results whose paths are all gone reads "No Items / The items listed here can no longer be found." Collapsed groups are each tab's own and are not saved.
- view-switch-keeps-selection: collapsing_every_group_keeps_its_headers switches from the list to the icons with every group collapsed and expects no selection, no message, and a header click to bring Projects back. With every group collapsed there is no row to reveal and the icon layout has only Header lines.
- type-select-space: `render_content`'s `#content` chain has one more listener before the double-click guard; an `.on_action` added there is independent of it.
- column-pane-selection-by-path, files-changed-off-thread, inactive-selection-colour, recents-walk-index, quick-look-empty-state: independent. src/finder/trash.rs has one new method, `trash_is_empty`, above `trash_now`, and the bar's button calls it.

Found, not fixed (all there before this change).
- A new folder or file whose row does not show freezes the file list. With the list grouped by kind and Folder collapsed, New Folder (its key, the Actions menu, or now the message's menu in an empty folder) makes "untitled folder", the Folder header's count goes up, and a name is being edited in a field that no row draws. Probed in an active window, as the app has it, with other groups open: the keyboard is in that field, so no key does anything; a click on a file's row selects nothing (click_row returns while a name is being edited); after a click on empty space or on the status bar the files have the keyboard and still take no arrow key and no click on a row, because the edit never ends. A field that was never drawn gets no blur, which is what ends an edit in inline_rename.rs, and `keyboard_lost` stays out while a name is being edited. The way out that was probed is a click on the group's header: the group opens with the field showing and the keyboard in it. By reading, going to another folder drops the edit, and so does leaving the window and coming back (`check_rename_field`). In the empty folder of this change (Folder collapsed in the tab, New Folder from the message's menu) the area shows the one collapsed header, Folder 1; before this change it went on saying "This folder is empty." with the folder in it and no header to click. `add_and_rename` (src/finder/inline_rename.rs) is the place: open the new item's group before the edit starts, and start no edit when no row shows the item (a filter can hide a new item the same way; not probed); or end an edit whose field the next frame does not draw. This one is worth a brief of its own.
- The status bar counts the rows that show. With groups collapsed it counts short: "0 items" under headers whose counts add up to the folder's, "7 items" with one group of 8 collapsed, and with a filter "N of M items pass the filter" leaves out the items that pass in collapsed groups, which makes the sentence false. A count taken in `rebuild_rows` between `apply_filter_to` and `group_rows` would be exact (the groups' `total` is not: it counts top-level items only).
- `item_menu_at` may guard nothing any more: the kit's context menus stop a right press at the innermost one (context_menu.rs, the bubble-phase listener), so `background_menu` is not built for a press on an item. The comment on the field still says that menus don't stop propagation. With the mark cleared at each press it does no harm; it could go, with `take_item_menu_click` and the two places that set it.
- The gallery has no empty-space menu while it has items, and an empty folder in column view shows the message in place of its columns.
- A right press on a button under a message gives that button the keyboard (the kit's doing; also in focus-lost-recovery's record).
